description: Proportion table, the same values the generator enforces, so a consumer can predict opening sizes without reading the GLB. Units meters. A floor's clear height is its floor-to-floor height minus clearHeightAllowance (slab plus ceiling zone). A standard-family window is windowHeight (a fraction of that clear height) tall on a sill inside the family's sill range; when the sill plus the height would pass the clear height, the sill drops to its minimum first and the height is trimmed last, never below the fraction's lower bound unless the floor itself is too short. An entrance door is entrance[0]..entrance[1] tall, capped by the ground floor's clear height. security and industrial are the documented small-window exceptions; poor tier keeps the megablock scatter (small, deep, semi-irregular) whatever the family says. A ground floor that is a venue or a lobby uses the storefront row instead of its family row.
